plugin.name: Cascading Select
field.label: Cascading select
field.description: Two linked dropdowns, the second one filtered by the first
input.stale: The saved {child} is no longer part of this {parent}
options.parentUid.label: Parent collection
options.parentUid.description: UID of the collection type listed in the first dropdown
options.parentLabelField.label: Parent label field
options.parentLabelField.description: Attribute shown as the option label. Empty: name, title, label or the first text attribute
options.childUid.label: Child collection
options.childUid.description: UID of the collection type listed in the second dropdown
options.childLabelField.label: Child label field
options.childLabelField.description: Attribute shown as the option label. Empty: name, title, label or the first text attribute
options.parentRelation.label: Relation to parent
options.parentRelation.description: Relation on the child pointing to the parent. Empty: detected automatically
options.syncRelation.label: Synced relation
options.syncRelation.description: Relation on this content type targeting the child collection. It is set from the selected child on every save
options.required.label: Required field
options.required.description: Both dropdowns must be filled (checked on publish when Draft & Publish is enabled)
options.private.label: Private field
options.private.description: This field will not show up in the API response
options.error.uid: Use a collection type UID such as api::atoll.atoll
